proposal.rationale: peer-01 and peer-03 both have readiness 'known' and advertise kem:mlkem768 (and kem:x25519mlkem768); peer-02 only advertises kem:x25519 and cannot support any PQ-capable profile, so it is left on its current path (not an unresolved dependency, just capability-incompatible with all allowlisted PQ profiles). Implementation liboqs-0.16.0 required for both PQ profiles is present on the asset. Two allowlisted profiles (tls13-hybrid-x25519-mlkem768 and tls13-mlkem768) each yield the same maximum of 2 ready endpoints (peer-01, peer-03); per the stated tie-breaker, the profile with the higher security class is preferred, and 'pqc' outranks 'hybrid-pqc' in the policy's security_class_order, so tls13-mlkem768 is proposed. This satisfies and exceeds the hybrid-pqc security floor.
